# speckit feature insert

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

Move first feature into an occupied position, rotating the contiguous block between the source and the destination one step toward the source: descending (to first smaller number) shifts each occupant `+1`, ascending (to first larger number) shifts each occupant `-1`

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit feature insert [OPTIONS] <TARGET> <POSITION>
```

## Help

```text
speckit feature insert --help
```
